2019 Q3.bq: Excluding the effects of the Alpha acquisition that closed on December 7th EnerSys reported third quarter fiscal 2019 adjusted earnings of $1.21 per diluted share, which fell slightly below our prior guidance range of $1.23 to $1.27.

2022 Q2.bq: Second quarter EPS rose slightly year-over-year to $1.01, although it was slightly below the bottom of our guidance range.

2025 Q4.bq: Adjusted EPS for the fourth quarter came in above the high end of our guidance range at $2.97 per share, an increase of 43% over the prior year.
